about: Projectors Zones knows. Zones.app puts the projector's picture full screen on the first one connected, matched by vendor, model and serial (macOS's display numbers change; these don't). Fields left out match anything. Add a new projector by running: sh app/displays.sh

projectors.name: SGD SX8
projectors.notes: Room 1, on the box in the corner beside the TV

projectors.name: EPSON PJ
projectors.notes: v1's projector, back on 2026-11-19. Max signal 1920x1080 @60Hz (no 2K/4K modes; EDID made 2024, maker code SEC). Bigger image than the SX8.
